_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

910.name: Early Settlement and Iron Age
910.label: Event
910.description: Stone Age hunter-gatherers; Bantu migration; early iron-working communities around Lake Malawi.

910.name: Stone Age Communities
910.label: Event
910.description: Stone tools and rock art around Lake Malawi; Hora Mountain and Mwanganda archaeological sites.

910.name: Bantu Migration and Iron Age
910.label: Event
910.description: Bantu-speaking peoples migrate into the region; Nkope and Kapeni ware pottery traditions; iron smelting and agriculture.

920.name: Maravi Kingdom and Confederacy
920.label: Event
920.description: Rise of the Maravi (Phiri clan) confederacy; Kalonga paramount chief; ivory and iron trade; origin of the name 'Malawi' (flames/fire).

920.name: Rise of the Maravi Confederacy
920.label: Event
920.description: Phiri clan establishes paramountcy; Kalonga as supreme ruler; network of subordinate chiefs (Undi, Lundu); territorial expansion.

920.name: Maravi Trade with the Coast
920.label: Event
920.description: Ivory trade with Portuguese Mozambique and Swahili coast; Maravi warriors (Zimba) raid as far as Mombasa; gradual fragmentation.

930.name: Slave Trade, Livingstone, and Early Contact
930.label: Event
930.description: Arab-Swahili slave trade devastation; David Livingstone's exploration; Scottish missionary and commercial ventures.

930.name: Arab-Swahili Slave Trade
930.label: Event
930.description: Yao and Swahili-Arab slave traders devastate the region; Jumbe of Nkhotakota; Mlozi bin Kazbadema in the north; massive depopulation.

930.name: Livingstone Reaches Lake Malawi
930.label: Event
930.description: David Livingstone reaches Lake Malawi (Lake Nyasa) 1859; witnesses slave trade horrors; calls for 'Commerce and Christianity'.

940.name: Nyasaland Protectorate
940.label: Event
940.description: British Central Africa then Nyasaland Protectorate; Chilembwe uprising; Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland; Banda's independence movement.

940.name: British Central Africa Protectorate
940.label: Event
940.description: Harry Johnston's administration; suppression of slave trade; plantation estates; hut tax and forced labour.

940.name: John Chilembwe Uprising 1915
940.label: Event
940.description: Reverend John Chilembwe leads armed revolt against colonial abuses and African conscription in WWI; killed by British forces.

950.name: Banda Dictatorship
950.label: Event
950.description: Hastings Kamuzu Banda's one-party rule; Life President; Malawi Young Pioneers; conservative Cold War alignment; suppression of dissent.

950.name: One-Party State and Cabinet Crisis
950.label: Event
950.description: Banda consolidates power; 1964 Cabinet Crisis — ministers who oppose him dismissed or flee; republic declared 1966; Life President 1971.

950.name: Banda's Authoritarian Rule
950.label: Event
950.description: Malawi Congress Party as sole legal party; Malawi Young Pioneers paramilitary; diplomatic ties with apartheid South Africa and Mozambique's RENAMO; strict social codes.

960.name: Democratic Malawi
960.label: Event
960.description: Multiparty democracy from 1994; Muluzi, Bingu, Joyce Banda, and Chakwera presidencies; development challenges; 2020 election re-run.

960.name: Democratic Transition 1994
960.label: Event
960.description: Referendum approves multiparty democracy June 1993; Bakili Muluzi wins 1994 elections; Banda era ends peacefully.

960.name: Bingu wa Mutharika and Joyce Banda
960.label: Event
960.description: Bingu wa Mutharika wins 2004; initially successful agricultural subsidy programme; dies in office 2012; Joyce Banda becomes Africa's second female head of state.
